_comment: Effort coefficients in man-days for each Z object type per S/M/L/XL category. Used by EffortEstimator. Edit in Preferences > Clean Core Analyzer.

categoryThresholds._comment: Used by EffortEstimator to pick S/M/L/XL for a given Z object.

profiles._comment: Per-scenario effort profiles. EffortRules.setActiveProfile(id) selects one. A profile starts from the top-level 'rules'/'categoryThresholds' (the 'default' base, backward-compatible) and may apply an 'effortMultiplier' and/or override specific 'rules' entries and 'categoryThresholds'. Unknown/missing profile => base is used.

report._comment: Project-level report settings consumed by ProjectEstimateBuilder. contingencyPct is added on top of summed MD; roleSplit ratios should sum to ~1.0 and split total MD across roles.

integration._comment: Per integration-inventory category default effort (category + man-days). Consumed by InventoryEffortEstimator; the active scenario effort multiplier is applied on top. usageCount=0 items are treated as retire (≈0 MD).
